title: Russian Ruble: CBR pause expected as inflation risks build – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects the Russian central bank to keep its key rate at 14.0%, arguing inflation fundamentals do not justify further easing despite weak growth.

title: British Pound remains weaker against Japanese Yen following UK economic data
summary: GBP/JPY depreciates after registering gains in the previous day, trading around 208.30 during Asian hours on Friday. The currency cross loses ground as the British Pound (GBP) remains subdued against the Japanese Yen (JPY) following the release of key economic data from the United Kingdom (UK).

title: Copper: Tariff risks keep prices vulnerable – ING
summary: ING’s Commodities Strategist Ewa Manthey notes that Copper has dropped sharply after a Reuters report suggested a US decision on refined Copper tariffs is still pending, highlighting how a tariff premium has driven prices beyond fundamentals.
